speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical activity?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been persistent for about three months, and the shortness of breath definitely gets worse when I try to play basketball or climb stairs. I usually don't have trouble breathing at night, but it feels much harder to keep up with my usual weekend activities lately. However, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Understood. Since your symptoms worsen with exertion and have persisted for three months, I need to check your oxygen saturation levels and listen to your lungs. Please hold still while I perform this physical exam.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pulmonary Hypertension
